label: resume_listen_status
purpose: Resume-only UART status observation; no upload, reset, BOOT or new CAN window requested. Not a motor experiment.
live_firmware_identity: Status agrees with prior two completed windows, but no fresh CONFIG/PROBE_CONFIG/ELF or flash readback; exact firmware identity not independently attested.
hardware_confirmation: Current motor power, wiring, LED steady/flashing and physical motion unknown; waiting for user.
limits: Zero received frames and unchanged rx within 3.156 seconds do not prove motor is unpowered/disconnected or establish bus health. Lifetime counters are not subtracted from old capture.
